title: What a normal plan and apply read and write

steps.title: Refresh
steps.note: Read the real objects tracked in state and update Terraform's view of them

steps.title: Compare
steps.note: Compare the configuration with that view; objects never imported stay invisible

steps.title: Plan
steps.note: A block with no state entry: create. A state entry with no block: destroy. Nothing changes yet.

steps.title: Apply
steps.note: Change real infrastructure to match the configuration, then record the result in state

caption: Follow the cards to see which of the three, configuration, state or real infrastructure, each step reads or changes.
